facts.text: Red Dog's at the door again. Give him a pie for the road and a pat for his trouble.
facts.why: John Grant doesn't say this. It is printed in quote marks. His real line when Red Dog first hops on his bus is 'All the sad faces in the world ain't gonna work, so you can just stop.'
facts.fix: All the sad faces in the world ain't gonna work, so you can just stop.

fix_note.text: All the sad faces in the world ain't gonna work, so you can just stop.

facts.why: The film and its plot summary only call it the town pub in Dampier; no source gives the name Dampier Hotel.
Same as the venue: the pub is never named Dampier Hotel in the film or the plot summary.

facts.text: John Grant's lunch, half of it for Red.
facts.why: The film never shows John sharing his lunch with Red; the miners do feed Red steak, so the line is changed to a plain pub joke.
facts.fix: The pub's lunch, half of it for Red.

vibe.verdict: A good Pilbara pub with the right food and feel, but the actual Red Dog stories are only lightly used.
